
usage:
  plat watchstation <flags> [stationname]
parameters:
  stationname              name of the station to view, or "daemon"
                             if the daemon's output is to be watched.
                             If omitted, the first/only station will be used
required flags:
  -h:<hostord>             ORD for the remote host
optional flags:
  -usr:<userName>          user name for the host's platform daemon
  -pwd:<password>          password for the host's platform daemon
  -follow                  if specified, the command will execute until
                             it is killed (ctrl-c), and will continue
                             to display output as the station produces it
  -f                       same as -follow
  -noinput                 if given, command will fail when username
                             and password are missing or incorrect,
                             instead of prompting and reading them
                             from stdin
  -p:<port>                port for the host's platform daemon
                             if omitted, default port 3011 or 5011 is used
  -secure                  if given, the connection will be encrypted with TLS
  -locale:<x>              set the default locale (en_US)
  -@<option>               pass option to Java VM
  -buildreg                force rebuild of the registry
